chunks: And this is a Book that We have revealed, blessed and confirming that which was before it, so that you may warn the Mother of the Towns and those around it. And those who believe in the Hereafter believe in it, and they are those who guard their prayers.

key_terms.أُمَّ الْقُرَىٰ: The Mother of Towns, a title for Mecca

ai.seo_question: What are the characteristics of true believers according to this verse in Surah Al-An'am?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the Quran's dual role as a confirmatory text (Musaddiq) to previous scriptures and a universal warning, with 'Umm al-Qura' often interpreted as Mecca or the center of religious authority. The emphasis on maintaining prayer (Salah) is frequently linked by scholars to the spiritual and physical discipline instilled by the Ahl al-Bayt, serving as a hallmark of true faith in the Hereafter.
